campbell.title: Campbell City Council — September 1, 2026
campbell.summary: The Campbell City Council considered a resolution to authorize a funding agreement with the Santa Clara Valley Transportation Authority's Low Carbon Transportation and Operations Program, aimed at improving transit reliability and performance systems. The agenda also touched on pothole damage and related claims processes.
keyTopics: Resolution authorizing execution of the Low Carbon Transportation and Operations Program fund agreement with VTA for transit reliability improvements
Pothole damage and the city's claims process

saratoga.title: Saratoga City Council — September 16, 2026
saratoga.summary: The Saratoga City Council took up routine business, including meeting minutes and vendor payments, along with two final map approvals for lot splits. The Council also considered two appeals of Planning Commission decisions—one involving a home and ADU on 6th Street, and another involving a three-lot subdivision on Oak Place—and discussed options for law enforcement services ahead of upcoming public town halls.
keyTopics: Appeal of Planning Commission conditions on a single-family home and ADU design review at 14650 6th Street
Appeal of Planning Commission approval of a three-lot subdivision (Tentative Map and Design Review) at 14486 Oak Place
Discussion of law enforcement service options ahead of September 19 and 30 town hall meetings
Final map approvals for lot splits at 20517 Carniel Avenue and 19351 Saratoga Los Gatos Road
Resolution amending the City's Conflict of Interest Code

los-altos.title: Los Altos City Council — September 8, 2026
los-altos.summary: The Los Altos City Council considered routine budget and contract items, including updated employee pay schedules and additional funding for an electrical maintenance contractor, alongside several policy discussions such as renaming Lee Street to Tubman Street and restructuring the Volunteer Awards Committee. The Council also took up a citizen-initiated request on zoning impacts, discussed the future of the Environmental Commission, and set direction for upcoming regional advocacy positions with CalCities.
keyTopics: Revised Fiscal Year 2026/27 pay schedules for city employee associations
Amendment No. 4 to the Bear Electrical Solutions maintenance contract, adding $250,000
Renaming Lee Street to Tubman Street
Restructuring the Joint Volunteer Awards Committee into a Los Altos-only committee
Citizen initiative on potential impacts to zoning

los-gatos.title: Los Gatos Town Council — September 15, 2026
los-gatos.summary: The Los Gatos Town Council reviewed routine business at this meeting, including approval of prior meeting minutes and the town's monthly financial report for July 2026. The Council also considered several contract actions, including amendments to service agreements and new professional services agreements.
keyTopics: Approval of minutes from the September 1, 2026 closed session and regular Town Council meetings
Monthly Financial and Investment Report for July 2026, including a corrected version
A second amendment to an existing agreement
A first amendment to a Heating, Ventilation and Air Conditioning (HVAC) services agreement
New professional services agreements for the Town

san-jose.body: Rules and Open Government Committee and Committee of the Whole
san-jose.title: San José Rules and Open Government Committee and Committee of the Whole — September 16, 2026
san-jose.summary: The Rules and Open Government Committee and Committee of the Whole reviewed the upcoming September 22 and September 29, 2026 City Council agendas and considered several special event approvals. The committee also took up a proposal regarding self-checkout safety standards for grocery and drug retail stores.
keyTopics: Review of September 22, 2026 final agenda and September 29, 2026 draft agenda, including possible new items and time-certain scheduling
Free use of the Janet Gray Hayes Rotunda on November 19, 2026 for a Santa Clara County Association of Realtors membership meeting, sponsored by Council District 9
Retroactive approval of the Santos Family Car Show as a Council District 4 sponsored special event
Retroactive approval of various Council District 5 sponsored special events
Proposal on self-checkout safety standards for grocery and drug retail stores, brought by Councilmembers Candelas and Cohen

mountain-view.title: Mountain View Youth Advisory Committee — September 14, 2026
mountain-view.summary: The Mountain View Youth Advisory Committee met to take public comments, participate in a team-building activity, and consider its work plan for the 2026-27 fiscal year. Committee members and staff also shared updates and reports.
keyTopics: Public oral communications
Team-building exercise for committee members
Fiscal Year 2026-27 Youth Advisory Committee Work Plan
Committee and staff comments and reports

sunnyvale.title: Sunnyvale City Council — September 19, 2026
sunnyvale.summary: This was a brief special morning session of the Sunnyvale City Council held ahead of the annual 'State of the City' event. The agenda covered only logistical matters, including the event schedule and standard public participation procedures, before the meeting was adjourned.
keyTopics: State of the City event schedule
Public comment procedures (in-person, online, and written)

cupertino.title: Cupertino City Council — September 15, 2026
cupertino.summary: The Cupertino City Council met on September 15, 2026, starting with closed-session discussions on potential litigation and property negotiations related to 10480 Finch Avenue with the Cupertino Union School District. The regular meeting included recognition of Cupertino High School students for their achievements at a national business leadership conference, along with a routine consent calendar covering meeting minutes, accounts payable, and several policy items. Notably, an ordinance updating building code definitions for attics, garages, and square footage was postponed to October 6, 2026.
keyTopics: Closed session on potential litigation and real property negotiations for 10480 Finch Avenue with Cupertino Union School District
Recognition of Cupertino High School students for their 2026 FBLA National Leadership Conference achievements
Postponement of an ordinance amending building code definitions (attic, garage, square footage) to October 6, 2026
Adoption of an Artificial Intelligence (AI) City Council Policy
Approval of the City's response to the Santa Clara County Civil Grand Jury report on pothole damage claims processes

santa-clara.title: Santa Clara City Council — August 25, 2026
santa-clara.summary: The Santa Clara City Council held a special meeting starting with interviews to fill two openings on the Civil Service Commission, followed by a joint session with the Stadium Authority Board. The Council considered janitorial services contract amendments, a historic preservation agreement for a Jackson Street property, annual workplans for city boards and commissions, and a voting delegate designation for an upcoming League of California Cities event.
keyTopics: Interviews and appointment of two applicants to the Civil Service Commission
Recognition of outgoing commissioners from several city boards and commissions, and of 2026 Mission Meets the Moment campaign sponsors
Contract amendment authorization for Impec Group's citywide janitorial services
Mills Act historic preservation agreement for 1261 Jackson Street
Review and approval of FY 2026-2027 workplans for city boards, commissions, and committees

milpitas.title: Milpitas City Council — September 15, 2026
milpitas.summary: The Milpitas City Council considered a draft plan for how the city will spend its federal Community Development Block Grant funds, along with a look at the condition of the Milpitas Community Center. The Council also reviewed the city's red light camera traffic safety program and took up financial actions related to closing out the former Redevelopment Agency, including refunding bonds.
keyTopics: Draft Program Year 2025 Community Development Block Grant Consolidated Plan
Red Light Camera Traffic Safety Program update
Condition assessment of the Milpitas Community Center
Successor Agency to the Redevelopment Agency resolutions
Sale and issuance of refunding bonds for the Successor Agency

palo-alto.title: Palo Alto Planning & Transportation Commission — September 9, 2026
palo-alto.summary: The Palo Alto Planning & Transportation Commission considered a proposed ordinance amending city zoning and building codes to address City Council direction on allowing accessory dwelling units (ADUs) to be sold separately from the main property. The Commission also received a Director's Report covering upcoming meeting schedules and commissioner assignments, and reviewed draft minutes from its August 12, 2026 meeting.
keyTopics: Proposed ordinance changes to allow separate sale of accessory dwelling units (ADUs)
Director's Report on meeting schedule and commissioner assignments
Approval of August 12, 2026 draft meeting minutes
